root_idea.summary: The root centers on a flash or gleam, especially the brief shining of lightning or a star, and extends to the momentary perception of a glance.
root_idea.development: From the core notion of something flashing or gleaming, the lexicon develops the related ideas of a quick or snatched look, reciprocal and causative looking, visible facial features, resemblance, and other figurative or specialized uses.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested group is displayed under the normalized verbal-noun citation form لَمْحٌ.

senses.definition: A flash, gleam, or twinkling, especially the instantaneous flash of lightning.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic comparison كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ and كَلَمْحٍ بِالْبَصَرِ, it depicts an event occurring with extreme instantaneousness, like a flash or twinkling.

senses.definition: A brief glance or light look.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ / كَلَمْحٍ بِالْبَصَرِ, the eye-glance supplies the comparison for extreme speed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To glance at, take a light or slight look at, or snatch a sight of someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also occurs with إِلَيْهِ and بِالْبَصَرِ. Some authorities extend the verb to simple looking, while another report restricts it to looking from a distance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the sight to extend or reach to a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction takes the sight as its subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shine, gleam, or glisten, said of lightning or a star.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the verbal shining sense, distinct from the nominal Quranic comparison.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To glance at one another or exchange brief looks.
To make someone glance or take a light, slight look.
To allow one's face or features to be glimpsed, especially by displaying and then concealing them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV construction describing the controlled revealing of facial charms or features.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For one's sight to be taken away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the passive Form VIII expression أَلْتُمِحَ بَصَرُهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the fixed expression لَأُرِيَنَّكَ لَمْحًا بَاصِرًا, a manifest, evident, or unmistakable matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Idiomatic expression; this interpretation is not a general standalone meaning of لَمْحٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A glance or light, slight look.
A shining, gleaming, or glistening of lightning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal derivative used for a flash or gleam of lightning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A likeness or point of resemblance in a person, such as a feature recalling a parent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense denotes a discernible resemblance or characteristic feature; the plural مَلَامِحُ is associated with this lexical item.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A visible facial feature or trait, including a beauty or defect of the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to the parts or features of a human face that are noticed in a quick or light look.
A specialized animal designation, synonymous with a keen or intelligent hawk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Shining, gleaming, or glistening, especially of lightning or a star.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Adjectival description of a luminous object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An intensive epithet for something that shines or gleams much.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The latter forms intensify the basic adjectival sense of shining.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A self-admiring man who looks at his own sides.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Fixed expression describing self-admiring bodily display.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who frequently glances or takes quick, slight looks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival designation for habitual or repeated glancing.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form I glance and snatched-look meaning; also directly supports the Quranic glance sense.
Directing the sight is covered by the Form I looking sense.
Shining or gleaming of lightning or a star.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the Form I entry.
Allowing the face or features to be glimpsed.
Passive expression for sight being taken away.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the Form I entry.
Imitative sequents whose lexical meaning belongs to سمح rather than لمح.
Fixed idiom for an evident or manifest matter.
Nominal shining or gleaming of lightning.
Visible beauties, defects, or features of the face.
Basic and intensive adjectival shining senses.

cautions: The two Quranic occurrences use لَمْحٌ within a comparison involving the eye; the flash/twinkling and brief-glance aspects are closely linked by that construction.
